title: Mars investigation at SRI just down the hall from the remote viewing program
summary: John Brandenburg tells of Mars investigation at SRI just down the hall from the remote viewing program, about 1980s at Stanford Research Institute, Menlo Park, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: same place where they they We found out later that the remote viewing program was just down the hall from the headquarters of the Mars investigation.

plain: A physicist named John Brandenburg, who argues that Mars once had life, says that in the 1980s a study of Mars was run out of SRI, the Stanford Research Institute in California. He says they found out later that the remote viewing program, an effort to describe faraway places using only the mind, was just down the hall from that Mars work. To him the closeness hints that the two projects were connected.
